copy.tagline: 用 Langfuse 追踪和优化 LLM 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 LLM 构建应用并需要可观测性
copy.tagline_en: Trace and optimize LLM apps with Langfuse
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build LLM apps and need observability

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为你的 LLM 应用添加可观测性：自动追踪 OpenAI 调用、管理提示词模板、记录评分和数据集，并确保数据在短生命周期进程中正确发送。
howto.when: 当你编写或调试 LLM 应用代码，需要追踪调用、管理提示词或评估输出质量时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Langfuse 追踪这个 OpenAI 调用。
创建一个提示词模板，变量是 topic。
给这个 trace 添加一个数值评分，名称为 relevance。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds observability to your LLM app: automatically traces OpenAI calls, manages prompt templates, records scores and datasets, and ensures data is flushed in short-lived processes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you write or debug LLM application code, need to trace calls, manage prompts, or evaluate output quality.

say_en.text: Help me trace this OpenAI call with Langfuse.
say_en.note: Claude will wrap the OpenAI client with observeOpenAI.

say_en.text: Create a prompt template with a variable named topic.
say_en.note: Claude will use LangfuseClient's prompt.get and compile methods.

say_en.text: Add a numeric score named relevance to this trace.
say_en.note: Claude will use langfuse.score.create to create the score.
